channel.description: Recent content in Retrieval on Harness Engineer

item.title: BrowseComp
item.description: A benchmark that evaluates AI agents on locating hard-to-find information, stressing search strategy, context management, and retrieval harness design under difficult conditions.

item.title: Olas Predict Benchmark
item.description: A benchmark for evaluating agents on historical prediction market data, testing harness design for research, retrieval, and forecasting in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

item.title: SWE-bench Verified
item.description: A strong benchmark for software engineering agents working against real GitHub issues and tests, which makes harness choices around retrieval, patching, and validation highly visible.

item.title: Every Agent Needs a Box — Aaron Levie, Box
item.description: Aaron Levie (Box CEO) on the infrastructure every agent needs: sandboxed “box” workspaces, agent identity and governance, permission models for agent-vs-human data access, and why context engineering (not infinite context windows) is the real bottleneck for enterprise knowledge-work agents. Includes Box’s internal agent eval methodology — rubric-scored retrieval across industry document sets — and the explore/exploit search limits of frontier models.
